name: Iran nuclear programme
value: No IAEA access to enrichment sites
summary: IAEA cannot verify Iran's enriched uranium and has never inspected a new underground enrichment plant
state: The IAEA said on 13 Nov it was concerned about an underground Iranian enrichment plant it has never inspected and could not verify the size or location of Iran's enriched uranium stockpile (The National). The Board of Governors reported Iran to the UN Security Council earlier this year (Arms Control Association). Searches to 27 Nov found no strike on a nuclear site, NPT withdrawal or evidence of weaponisation, so Watch holds.
for_you: Uncertainty over Iran's nuclear material adds to Gulf tension. Travellers should follow FCDO travel advice for Iran and the region.
rubric_hit: Inspector access curtailed; HEU unverified; no strike on nuclear sites

sources.title: The National — IAEA expresses concern over Iranian underground uranium enrichment plant
Arms Control Association — IAEA Reports Iran to UN Security Council

why: A nuclear-armed Iran — or strikes to prevent one — could ignite the Gulf and send oil far higher.
drivers: Enrichment levels, IAEA access, Israeli/US military posture, snapback sanctions, talks.

rubric.alert: Strikes on nuclear sites, NPT withdrawal, or evidence of weaponisation.
rubric.watch: Enrichment at ≥ 60% or inspector access curtailed, or credible strike threats.
rubric.normal: IAEA access and active diplomacy; no escalation.
